title: High-Performance Substrate — Phased Implementation Roadmap
principle: Postgres migration (docs/json/governance/postgres_*.v1.v1.json) is a separate parallel track. This roadmap adds high-performance adjacent tooling alongside Postgres integration, not instead of it. No phase should add a dependency that replaces or undermines Postgres operational authority or artifact-first doctrine.

phases.name: Audit (current)
phases.description: This audit. No code changes. No dependency changes. Produce governance JSON artifacts that classify 19 tools, define fit matrix, architecture pipeline, dependency doctrine, test strategy, and security review.
phases.exit_criteria: All deliverables validated as syntactically correct JSON. Schema validation passes (no regressions).

phases.name: Measurement Harness & Low-Hanging Fruit
phases.description: Identify actual bottlenecks before adding any tools. Expand Zstandard usage and Pydantic exploitation — zero new dependencies. Runs parallel to Postgres Phase 1 (Schema Contracts).

tasks.task: Measure JSONL parse times for 10k, 100k, 1M row corpora using stdlib json
Measure DuckDB projection compute times for each cockpit widget query
Benchmark receipt_store list() with 1k, 10k, 100k envelopes
Benchmark event_store read() with 10k, 100k, 1M events
Measure static docs render time for current page count vs projected 500+ pages
Measure procurement evidence pack generation time for sample artifact set
Expand Zstandard: replace gzip in session lifecycle finalize with zstd
Expand Zstandard: add zstd option to rig_relay_create_telemetry_bundle.py
Expand Pydantic: replace stdlib json in receipt_store manifest lines with Pydantic model
Expand Pydantic: replace stdlib json in event_store append with EventEnvelope model serialization

phases.deliverables: Measurement report JSON artifact. Zstandard-expanded session/bundle compression code. Pydantic-expanded module boundaries.
phases.exit_criteria: All bottlenecks quantified. Zstandard expansion tested (roundtrip compress/decompress). Pydantic expansion pyright-clean. No regression in existing tests.
phases.rollback: Revert zstd expansion to gzip (already coexisting). Revert Pydantic expansion to stdlib json (simple code revert).

phases.name: Port Definition & File-Backed Adapters
phases.description: Define Port interfaces. Implement file-backed reference adapters. Runs parallel to Postgres Phase 2 (Port Definition & File Adapters). This phase is SHARED with Postgres migration — same ports, same file adapters.

tasks.task: Define all Port protocols (same as Postgres audit Phase 2)
Implement file-backed adapters
Exploit Pydantic: all adapter boundaries use model_validate/model_dump_json, never raw json.loads/dumps

phases.deliverables: Port protocols + file-backed adapters + contract tests. Pydantic-typed boundaries.
phases.exit_criteria: All file adapters pass contract tests. Pydantic exploited at all adapter boundaries. Existing tests pass.
phases.rollback: Remove rig_relay/adapters/ directory. Existing stores unchanged.

phases.name: Postgres Adapters + COPY + Arrow Prototype
phases.description: Implement Postgres adapters. Add psycopg 3. Implement COPY-based ingest/export with staging table pattern. Prototype Arrow in-memory interchange behind ProjectionStorePort. Formalize Parquet derived snapshot doctrine. Runs parallel to Postgres Phase 3.

tasks.task: Add psycopg 3
Implement Postgres adapters with COPY bulk ingest/export
Prototype Arrow table behind ProjectionStorePort (optional [arrow] extra)
Formalize Parquet derived snapshot doctrine in tests

phases.deliverables: Postgres adapters + COPY pipeline + Arrow prototype (if justified) + Parquet doctrine tests.
phases.exit_criteria: Postgres adapters pass integration tests. COPY staging table validates constraints. Arrow prototype produces equivalent projections to dict-of-dicts (if promoted from park). Parquet-never-canonical test passes.
phases.rollback: Remove psycopg, pyarrow (if added). Remove Postgres adapters. Run down migrations.

phases.name: Replay Equivalence & Cross-Adapter Contract Tests
phases.description: Verify file-backed and Postgres adapters produce equivalent projections. Verify DuckDB and Postgres produce equivalent analytical views. Runs parallel to Postgres Phase 4.
phases.deliverables: Equivalence test suite. DuckDB vs Postgres projection parity tests. Arrow vs dict projection parity (if Arrow prototype exists).
phases.exit_criteria: Equivalence tests pass for all canonical artifact types. DuckDB and Postgres projections match. Arrow and dict projections match (if Arrow exists).
phases.rollback: No schema changes. Remove test files if needed.

phases.name: Cockpit Integration + Zstandard Bundles
phases.description: Desktop cockpit uses ProjectionStorePort. Zstandard-compressed evidence bundles and export packages. Cockpit projection performance measured against baseline. Runs parallel to Postgres Phase 5 (Cockpit Integration).
phases.dependencies: zero new (pg_jsonschema is Postgres extension, not Python dep — parked, not implemented)
phases.deliverables: Cockpit queries Postgres materialized views. Zstandard-compressed bundles. Projection performance report.
phases.exit_criteria: Cockpit widgets render from Postgres views. Zstandard bundles pass roundtrip decompress + content-light scan. Projection performance meets baseline or improves.
phases.rollback: Cockpit falls back to file-backed projection. Zstandard falls back to gzip.

phases.name: Enterprise Mode + pgvector Audit
phases.description: Enterprise mode with Postgres operational substrate. pgvector semantic retrieval audit (parked — evaluate as separate slice). Audit requires: sensitive-derived-data policy for embeddings, embedding model selection, local-only boundary. Runs parallel to Postgres Phase 6 (Enterprise Mode).
phases.dependencies: pgvector Python client if promoted from park to prototype

tasks.task: Enterprise mode toggle
Audit pgvector for semantic retrieval over content-light report corpus
Define sensitive-derived-data policy for embeddings

phases.deliverables: Enterprise mode. pgvector audit report. Sensitive-derived-data policy.
phases.exit_criteria: Enterprise mode toggle works. pgvector audit complete. Sensitive-derived-data policy defined and validated.

phases.name: Procurement Docs + SQLGlot Linting
phases.description: Procurement-grade documentation. SQLGlot linting for DuckDB ↔ Postgres SQL parity (parked — evaluate as optional validation tool). Runs parallel to Postgres Phase 7 (Procurement Documentation).
phases.deliverables: Procurement documentation. SQLGlot linting report (if promoted).
phases.exit_criteria: Procurement docs validated. SQLGlot detects dialect-specific SQL if promoted.

phases.name: Park Candidates Re-evaluation
phases.description: Re-evaluate parked candidates (Polars, Ibis, DataFusion, ADBC, Iceberg) based on measured bottlenecks from Phase 1 and operational experience from Phases 3-7.
phases.deliverables: Updated fit matrix with operational data.
phases.exit_criteria: Bottleneck evidence justifies promotion or confirms park/reject.
